title: Output schema of kensho-sweep-mcp
description: kensho-sweep-mcp exposes a Streamable HTTP MCP server on the Apify standby container (APIFY_CONTAINER_PORT). It produces no dataset or key-value store output; its result is the MCP tool interface itself. Connect an MCP client to the standby URL and call current_sweep, sweep_history, or top_prize_movers.
